newsitem.title: BELGIUM: GENERALE BANK CUTS CBR TO 'HOLD'.
newsitem.headline: GENERALE BANK CUTS CBR TO 'HOLD'.

text.p: Belgium's Generale Bank said on Thursday it would cut its recommendation to investors for shares in Belgian cement maker CBR to 'hold' from 'buy' after disappointing results from CBR.
The bank said CBR's 12.1 percent increase in 1996 group net earnings to 4.3 billion Belgian francs and a 1.6 percent fall in cashflow to 9.6 billion francs were "slightly disappointing".

Generale Bank was awaiting more details on the results, but said that after the CBR share reached new highs in the past few days, it cut its recommendation on CBR to 'hold'. CBR was down 55 francs at 3,445 at 0920 GMT on the Brussels bourse.
"Management, however, remains optimistic on the 1997 outlook for all regions where CBR operates. Furthermore, more expansion in new regions is considered," Generale Bank said in a note.
CBR is a unit of Germany's Heidelberger Zement .
